name: Screen Tutorial
summary: The screen recording leads. The view zooms to wherever the cursor is working, numbered step cards keep the viewer oriented, callouts circle the exact button, and a small face bubble keeps it human.
best_for: Software and app founders, tool and spreadsheet educators, automation builders and onboarding teams. 30-90 second how-to-do-X-in-N-steps videos and product walkthroughs.
why_it_works: Showing the finished result in the first 2s with a numbered promise (3 steps) is the open loop: the viewer stays to get it. Zooming to the cursor makes small UI readable on a phone, which is what keeps tutorials from being swiped. Cutting all waiting keeps a change every 2-3s, and a new step card every 8-20s is the pattern interrupt that also signals progress. The recap checklist before the CTA drives saves.

preview.motion_sample: A mock app window zooms smoothly toward a cursor with a yellow halo, a click ring ripples, a yellow outline draws around a button, and a numbered step tag slides in from the left in tall condensed type.
